title: Docker permission error preventing audit log verification
description: The verification system encountered a Docker permission error when attempting to check audit logs, preventing confirmation of whether the agent's find-credential task actually succeeded in the backend.
symptoms: Verification fails with Docker permission error
root_cause_hint: Docker socket permissions or container access configuration may be incorrect for the verification harness to query the platform's audit logs.
evidence: [bug] task=find-credential | Agent narration claims success finding test API via CLI search/inspect, but verification failed due to Docker permission error preventing audit log check. Discrepancy between agent's perceived success and verification failure.
